assumptions: BLIND RECOUNT (swe lane, swap check A) — written before reading any swe2 tally.

CLI `vsi` -> vsi_planes -> prepare_with_downscale (kernel.rs:1381-1418): sdsp saliency map per image at FIXED 256x256 (SDSP_N:14), then decimation_factor F = max(1, round(min/256)) (kernel.rs:30-33) box-decimates L/a/b + both sm planes; scharr_mag on decimated L; pool_body sums.
Ingress: Input holds rgb f32 planes + Lab planes (srgb_to_lab kernel.rs:981-1015: XYZ linear -> Lab f()/kappa, ~30 flops/px incl 3x8 matmul).

sdsp (kernel.rs:1068-1196): per image: 3x imresize (w,h)->256^2 (tri kernel, axis_taps ~ratio+2 taps per out el), 3x (fft2 256^2 + LG mul + ifft2), sf=sum sq combine, Gaussian center prior (65536 exp once per size — counted), min/max scan of a,b, arg/e = exp(-(dist a,b)^2/(2 sigma^2)) per el, imresize 256^2 -> (w,h). SDSP cost is ~CONSTANT in input size (65536-el domain) plus the two resizes which scale with W*H/F-in ratio.

imresize (kernel.rs:534-614): antialiased tri-window per-axis; per out el ~ (in/out)+2 taps per axis -> modeled ~2*min(in/out+2) fma; for sdsp-in (min->256) it's input-ratio taps; folded to ~30 flops/el on the 65536-el domain + the sm upsample out to (w,h) ~ 4 taps/el out.
scharr_mag (kernel.rs:1309-1330): DX/DY 3x3 convs + sqrt(ix^2+iy^2) on decimated L.
pool (kernel.rs:1451-1544): per el vssim+gsim+isim+qsim rationals (4x7 flops + 4 div), gsim^0.4 powf, iq=isim*qsim sign-corrected pow^0.02, w=max(sm1,sm2), contrib=gp*vs*iqreal*w, f64 num/den.

stages.name: sRGB8 -> f32 rgb planes + Lab
stages.notes: rgb planes for sdsp + Lab (linearize + XYZ matmul + Lab f(t) piecewise).

stages.name: lab 3ch resize (w,h)->256^2 (tri kernel)
stages.notes: Antialiased resize; taps ~ input/output ratio per axis.

stages.name: 3ch fft2+LG+ifft2 on 256^2
stages.notes: 5*n*log2(n) per transform, 6 total + LG complex mults + sf sq-accum (2mul+add).

stages.name: gaussian center prior + chroma dist exp
stages.notes: gw prior + ab min/max + arg/e exp fold.

stages.name: box decimate L,a,b + sm by F, 4 planes x2 img
stages.notes: F^2 box + normalize per out el per plane (l,m,n,sm x2).

stages.name: DX/DY 3x3 + magnitude on decimated L
stages.notes: Two convs per el + mag sqrt folded (0.5/el amortized).

stages.name: 4 sims + 2 powf + weight + f64 pool
stages.notes: vssim/gsim/isim/qsim + powf(gsim,0.4) + powf(|iq|,0.02)*sign + max weight + 2 f64 adds. score=num/den once.
